review_candidates.company: 杭州协力科技有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 Position Overview Lead a small Shanghai WFOE assembly and testing operation for Company laboratory instrumentation, combining hands-on electronics engineering with team supervision, inventory integrity, production scheduling, quality and operational controls in Jiading District. Coordinate closely with U.S. Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality and Supply Chain. 负责领导上海嘉定一家小型外商独资企业的装配和测试业务，该业务涉及公司实验室仪器仪表，将电子工程实践与团队监督、库存完整性、生产调度、质量和运营控制相结合。与美国制造、工程、质量和供应链部门密切协调。 Manufacturing and Team Leadership生产制造与团队管理 Plan and direct daily assembly, testing, and shipment preparation to meet quality and delivery requirements. 规划和指导日常的装配、测试和发货准备工作，以满足质量和交货要求。 Supervise and train assemblers, test technicians and inventory associates; set priorities and provide performance feedback. 监督和培训装配工、测试技术人员和库存管理员；设定优先级并提供绩效反馈。 Maintain production records and report output, issues, staffing and improvement opportunities to U.S. management. 维护生产记录，并向美国管理层报告产量、问题、人员配置情况和改进机会。 Electronics and Technical Support 电子与技术支持 Read schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, bills of materials and work instructions. 阅读原理图、接线图、工程图纸、物料清单和作业指导书。 Lead troubleshooting, functional testing, calibration, configuration and approved repairs of electronic and electromechanical instrumentation. 负责电子和机电仪器的故障排除、功能测试、校准、配置以及经批准的维修工作。 Use multimeters, oscilloscopes and other diagnostic tools; coordinate complex issues and engineering changes with U.S. teams. 使用万用表、示波器和其他诊断工具；与美国团队协调复杂问题和工程变更。 Inventory and Materials Control 存货与物料管理 Oversee receipt, identification, storage, issuance, cycle counts and reconciliation of parts and finished goods. 负责零部件和成品的接收、识别、储存、发放、周期盘点和对账工作。 Maintain accurate ERP transactions, material traceability, revision control and FIFO practices as applicable. 保持准确的ERP交易记录、物料可追溯性、修订控制以及适用的先进先出（FIFO）原则。 Coordinate shortages, replenishment, discrepancies and shipment documentation with purchasing, logistics and approved customs providers. 与采购部门、物流部门以及经批准的海关服务提供商协调处理货物短缺、补货、差异以及装运文件相关事宜。 Quality, Safety and Operational Controls质量、安全和运营管理 Enforce approved work instructions, inspection and testing standards, equipment calibration and product release criteria. 执行已批准的工作指令、检验和测试标准、设备校准以及产品放行准则。 Document nonconformances, rework, scrap and corrective actions; restrict unauthorized changes and material dispositions. 记录不合格项、返工、报废和纠正措施；限制未经授权的更改和材料处置。 Maintain safe work practices, organized work areas, appropriate records and compliance with applicable Chinese requirements and CEM policies. 保持安全的工作习惯、整洁的工作区域、适当的记录，并遵守适用的中国法规和CEM政策。 Coordinate facility maintenance and service vendors within delegated authority; escalate material financial, safety or compliance issues. 在授权范围内协调设施维护和服务供应商；上报重大财务、安全或合规问题。 Required Qualifications 任职资格 Bachelor’s degree in Electronic Information Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Automation, Mechanical Design, Manufacturing and Automation, Automation or closely related engineering discipline. 电子信息工程、电气工程及其自动化、机械设计制造及其自动化、自动化或相关工程学科的学士学位。 Five or more years in electronics/electromechanical manufacturing, testing or manufacturing engineering; two or more years leading technicians or production activities. 具备五年或以上电子/机电制造、测试或制造工程经验；两年或以上领导技术人员或生产活动的经验。 Demonstrated hands-on electronics diagnostics and knowledge of production control, inventory, ERP/MRP and quality documentation. 具备电子设备诊断的实践经验，并熟悉生产控制、库存管理、ERP/MRP以及质量文档管理。 Strong problem solving, communication, organization and ability to independently lead a small facility. 具备出色的解决问题、沟通、组织能力，以及独立领导小型设施的能力。 Preferred Qualifications 加分项 Experience with laboratory instrumentation or precision electronics; ISO 9001, and new-site setup. 具有实验室仪器或精密电子设备方面的经验；熟悉ISO 9001标准，并具备新厂区设置经验。 Experience working with international manufacturing and engineering teams; professional English communication and fluent Mandarin. 具有与国际制造和工程团队合作的经验；具备专业的英语交流能力和流利的普通话。
